## 2.5.0 (2026-11-08)

### Summary

Version 2.5.0 replaces the previous family snapshot and rebind machinery with session-owned settings stored in native session metadata: the resolved roles, orchestration profile, and plugin toggles of the effective configuration are recorded once for a session family's root and resolved through lineage for every member, while read-modify-write updates preserve unrelated metadata. Settings are now changed explicitly through the new `vvoc session set --session <id>` command (preset, profile, role, plugin toggle, or pull-defaults) and the TUI `/vv-settings` command, so only the named family changes; the `--force` and `--session` rebind flags on preset, role, and plugin commands and the `/vv-rebind` command are removed, and all native plugins read their policy through the shared settings service instead of the deleted snapshot configFor/accept pair. Controller guidance was also consolidated into the bundled seven-section template delivered exactly once by system-context-injection without duplicate injection, with other primary agents receiving shared guidance fragments. Documentation, GRACE projections, the real-host harness cases, and integration tests were synchronized for session settings, including isolated workflow test persistence and stability of recorded settings across configuration changes and host restarts.

* fix(prompts): consolidate controller guidance without duplicate injection ([1ce1636](https://github.com/osovv/vv-opencode/commit/1ce1636))
* test: isolate workflow integration persistence root per process ([47b63eb](https://github.com/osovv/vv-opencode/commit/47b63eb))
* test(e2e): rewrite the real-host harness for session settings ([216724c](https://github.com/osovv/vv-opencode/commit/216724c))
* test(secrets-redaction): drop the removed admission error name from drift notes ([ac91757](https://github.com/osovv/vv-opencode/commit/ac91757))
* test(workflow): align the settings-stability scenario title with session-owned settings ([88cca8a](https://github.com/osovv/vv-opencode/commit/88cca8a))
* docs: synchronize README and GRACE projections for session settings ([4a5f92c](https://github.com/osovv/vv-opencode/commit/4a5f92c))
* feat(cli): explicit session-settings commands for one family ([5b9e727](https://github.com/osovv/vv-opencode/commit/5b9e727))
* feat(plugins): resolve plugin policy through the family settings service ([1bac194](https://github.com/osovv/vv-opencode/commit/1bac194))
* feat(runtime): store family settings in native session metadata ([8774209](https://github.com/osovv/vv-opencode/commit/8774209))
* refactor(prompts): dedupe vv-controller template sections into universal injection ([4edde2e](https://github.com/osovv/vv-opencode/commit/4edde2e))

## <small>2.4.0 (2026-11-04)</small>

### Summary

Version 2.4.0 closes the verified agent-facing workflow, managed-prompt sync, doctor, and reflection gaps. Managed skills and agents now describe the literal `VVOC_WORK_ITEM_ID: wi-<n>` launch header, the state-to-agent map, the standalone `work_item_open` field rule, and controller-only work-item lifecycle, so workers copy the assignment header instead of a sample id. `vvoc sync` refreshes legacy inline managed `{file:...}` system prompts, preserves and reports user-owned inline sources, and deduplicates `skills` roots by real path; `vvoc doctor` warns about stale managed prompts and skills, duplicate skill roots, and deprecated permission actions such as `apply_patch`, while missing file references remain fail-closed problems. The bundled `vv-reflect` extractor gains a streaming `--archive` mode with since/until/project/agent/skill filters, call-id deduplication, legacy `part` union, deterministic JSON/Markdown output, and a documented machine-wide workflow. README and GRACE context now point at the native `opencode/agents` discovery path and describe legacy `vvoc/agents` files as migration inputs.

### Summary

Analytics now records the OpenCode host version from the native app identity, so usage records stay correctly attributed on 2.2 hosts that no longer deliver session lifecycle events, and session titles are recovered lazily from the native session record with bounded retries while a failed read never blocks a usage record. The isolated host contract matrix was also made self-consistent on OpenCode 2.2.5 by pinning every vvoc role to the cohort model and keeping the isolated vvoc config at the host child's working directory, and a nonzero host exit now prints bounded stderr and stdout tails so matrix failures are diagnosable.

* fix(analytics): attribute host version from the native app and recover titles lazily ([39ab5ac](https://github.com/osovv/vv-opencode/commit/39ab5ac))

### Summary

Version 2.3.2 fixes a mismatch between the published package manifest and the runtime host-compatibility range. The previous release declared engines.opencode as >=2.0.18 <2.0.19 even though the runtime already supported >=2.0.18 <3.0.0, which could cause installs to be rejected on otherwise supported OpenCode hosts. The manifest now declares the same widened window as the runtime, and a regression test pins engines.opencode to the host-compat range so the two cannot drift apart again. Users on supported newer hosts should now be able to install and use the package without a false compatibility failure.

* fix(host-compat): declare the widened host window in engines.opencode ([8dc3117](https://github.com/osovv/vv-opencode/commit/8dc3117))

### Summary

Version 2.3.1 widens OpenCode host compatibility from an exact 2.0.18 pin to a major-bounded supported window of >=2.0.18 <3.0.0, backed by a data-driven verified-host list, so routine upstream patch and minor releases no longer block vvoc install, init, sync, or launch. In-window hosts without live-host evidence are now classified as tolerated and reported with a single warning, while versions outside the window still fail closed before any config write. The release also reports the support level and verified hosts in vvoc status and doctor, moves build pins to 2.2.5 with matching effect and TUI peers, parameterizes the live host gates by the host version under test, and adds a host:check drift reporter plus documented host-update procedure so maintainers can classify new upstream releases and refresh verified evidence without ad-hoc changes.

* feat(host-compat): major-bounded host window with verified list ([65a7eda](https://github.com/osovv/vv-opencode/commit/65a7eda))

issues.title: workflow: revertInFlightDelegatedLaunches is dead code — delegated attempts orphaned by a host crash stay in_flight forever (ATTEMPT_IN_FLIGHT, no recover path)
runtime: family-snapshot admission rejects its own first-work model switch — bare sessions whose creation model differs from roles.default die on first dispatch (SnapshotAdmissionError, 2.4.0)
workflow: a checkpoint reviewer launch that dies at transport permanently binds the generation slot (ALREADY_LAUNCHED deadlock, no recover path)
vv-plan/vv-spec: XML-authoring hazards undocumented; the lint accepts malformed XML that a strict parser rejects; self-review lacks a contract-fidelity check
